antiScam.pageDesc: A few markers to move forward in confidence and recognize the traps of romance scams.
antiScam.redFlag_money: You're asked for money, a transfer, a gift card or crypto.
antiScam.redFlag_urgency: Sudden urgency or pressure to decide quickly.
antiScam.redFlag_offplatform: Pushing to leave the platform (WhatsApp, email) very early.
antiScam.redFlag_identity: Inconsistencies in the story or identity; refusing a video call.
antiScam.redFlag_sobstory: A sob story (illness, military abroad, blocked inheritance).
antiScam.redFlag_pressure: Declarations of love or marriage pressure very quickly.
antiScam.step_never: Never send money, and never share bank details.
antiScam.step_slow: Take your time: a healthy relationship is not rushed.
antiScam.step_video: Suggest a video call before sharing personal information.
antiScam.step_tools: Use Report and Block — free, anytime.
antiScam.step_coach: When in doubt, talk to a verified coach.
antiScam.reminder: Your safety comes first. When in doubt, report and block — no need to justify yourself.
antiScam.bannerBody: This conversation shows patterns we've seen in scams. Take your time, and never share money or sensitive details.
